status_reason: The monkey set follows the paper's combined threshold series (2-s stochastic motion display, saccade report to two targets, reward, correction trials) but on a frame-based display, with fixed example aperture, axis and speed instead of values matched to each recorded MT neuron; the human set changes the population and the response (keys); the neurometric half needs an MT recording that this folder does not provide.

original.citation: Britten, K. H., Shadlen, M. N., Newsome, W. T., & Movshon, J. A. (1992). The analysis of visual motion: A comparison of neuronal and psychophysical performance. Journal of Neuroscience, 12(12), 4745-4765.
original.experiments: The combined threshold series (psychophysics with simultaneous MT recording): its behavioural task in full, its neurometric analysis as code that needs a recording; not the direction-tuning or physiological threshold series

notes: Keyboard: human set only. Eye tracker and reward: monkey set only. Recording is optional and not provided: configs/rig-recording-example.yaml shows the sync lines and recording block a lab adds for the neurometric half. No participant data: tests and simulated sessions verify the software only.
